PROTOCOL_DEVIATION_SELF_REPORTED.what: budget.maximum_runs was 1; the producer made TWO full measurement invocations. Invocation 3 (03:53:22Z) had a DEFECTIVE DERIVATION in the producer's own analysis code (negative C_samp from an OLS extrapolation) and is superseded; invocation 4 (03:57:07Z) is the archived one. BOTH are reported in the deliverable; neither is omitted.
PROTOCOL_DEVIATION_SELF_REPORTED.coordinator_position: RECORDED AS A DEVIATION, NOT WAIVED. A declared budget was exceeded and the producer said so unprompted, which is the behaviour the harness wants; but AGENTS.md rule 3 makes budgets part of the frozen protocol, and a self-reported breach is still a breach. The measurement layer of the superseded invocation was sound and is quoted as a second sample, so the deviation COST NOTHING and arguably improved the result - that is a mitigation, not an exoneration. The reviewers are asked to confirm invocation 3's data is genuinely quoted rather than quietly dropped.
PROTOCOL_DEVIATION_SELF_REPORTED.second_deviation: The split of work between calib_m0.py (array/RNG) and calib_m0b.py (big-integer plus derivation) is the producer's RECONSTRUCTION: BATCH-003 section 9.1 names both scripts but never says which measured what. Recorded so no reviewer mistakes the split for a recovered original.

what_this_snapshot_does_not_establish: NOTHING about HQC. No HQC object was constructed, sampled or decoded; runs_authorized 0 was honoured for the confirmatory measurement.
NOT that BATCH-003's cost model is correct - see the composition-aware divergence below.

producer_report_forwarded_to_review.the_infeasible_verdict_cannot_flip: T_req contains NO machine constant, so nothing measured here can move it. It reproduced EXACTLY: PS-R1 k=16 at 2.9150e7 against 2.915e7, dup=2 at 1.4729e24 against 1.473e24, PS-A k=16 at 3.4008e41 against 3.40e41. Flipping INFEASIBLE would need a 2.8e15x speedup.
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.like_for_like_corroborates_batch_003: Using BATCH-003's own formula with the newly measured constants, C_trial comes out 0.83-0.90x and the mandatory total 4.92e4 against 5.58e4 core-seconds (0.88x), with the same run count of 8. Their unreproducible constants were, as far as this can tell, right.
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.composition_aware_does_not: With two composition changes the producer flags, C_trial is 2.48-3.67x and the total 1.61e5 core-seconds (2.88x).
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.ONE_VERDICT_ADJACENT_FIGURE_FLIPS: NOT the mathematics - THE DECLARED RUN BUDGET. Composition-aware, the mandatory work needs 14 RUNS against the contract's declared maximum_runs of 12, and stage B1 needs 6 SHARDS against its declared 3. A contract frozen with the old budget would be under-provisioned on its own terms.
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.the_red_teams_dup2_rung: PS-R2 costs 1.73e4 core-seconds like-for-like, 0.86x its quoted 2.005e4 - so the rung's affordability is CORROBORATED on the same basis the quote used. Composition-aware it is 5.36e4, moving from 31 percent to 96 PERCENT of the mandatory budget. Whether it stays in the protocol is therefore sensitive to which basis is adopted, and the reviewers should decide that explicitly rather than by default.
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.optimistic_assumptions_flagged: Eight, of which the sharpest is that BATCH-003's declared 2x contingency IS EXCEEDED BY MEASUREMENT - two composition effects alone give 2.5-3.7x. Also: perfect 4-core scaling entirely unmeasured with the memory-bound rate already 6x below cache-resident; a transform priced at large-array throughput where length-128 throughput is 16x lower; a bare shift+XOR pricing a cyclic ring product that needs a masked rotate (2.0-2.3x); and stage C/D carried verbatim and NOT RE-DERIVABLE AT ALL because no trial counts are stated. Two assumptions are flagged in the PESSIMISTIC direction for symmetry.
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.internal_inconsistencies_found_in_batch_: Three, all sub-3 percent and none verdict-changing: omega_e present in C_samp at PS-A but absent at PS-R1/R3/R5; C_prod evaluated at n for PS-A but at N for PS-R1; a printed C_trial exceeding 2x its printed components. The stage layer composes exactly, which CONFIRMS the BATCH-003 validator's finding that the defect was in the inputs rather than the arithmetic.
